Life at Silk

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion

At Silk, we believe that a diverse set of experiences, identities, and backgrounds makes us strong and better. We work every day to foster an environment where people of all backgrounds belong and excel.

Giving Back

We believe in contributing to the well-being of the communities around us. Every year our employees actively participate in the causes we care about most, including school supply drives, toy drives, STEM clubs for youth, and more.

Hybrid and Flexible Work

Innovation and disruption can happen anywhere, which is why we give employees the flexibility to work where they can work best -- hybrid, remote, and in-office.
